articles.title: Anthony LaPaglia: ‘There is not a role I didn’t get that I ever gave more than four hours of grievance to – even Tony Soprano’
articles.summary: The actor on surviving 2000s network television in Without a Trace, the role that made him take Brad Pitt seriously, and leaving the US to ‘ride out Trump’ Get our weekend culture and lifestyle email. I didn’t know before reading your new memoir that you were almost Tony Soprano.
body: It’s not Tony Soprano. There is not a role that I didn’t get that I ever gave more than four hours of grievance to. When I don’t get something, I move on. Because there’s no point. I’m very pragmatic that way. It’s for your own mental health. Once it’s gone, it’s gone.
If you were casting your dream project with three actors you’ve already worked with, plus one new face, who would be on your team?
Allison Janney. Kerry Armstrong. Alison Whyte. And a new face … I just saw Moneyball and I don’t think I ever took Brad Pitt that seriously but that guy is phenomenal. Great movie.
Acting opposite Janney in A View from the Bridge on Broadway sounds as though it was a transcendental experience for you.

articles.summary: Cynthia Erivo spoofed “Wicked” during her stint hosting “SNL U.K.,” this time taking on the role of Glinda in “Nigerian Wicked.” Alongside Ayoade Bamgboye as Elphaba, Erivo — dressed in a blonde wig and pink velour tracksuit — starred in a lo-fi, melodramatic version of the Oscar-nominated musical…
body: The sketch also reimagines Glinda and Elphaba’s makeover scene, with Elphaba saying: “Glinda, I can’t afford this!”

articles.title: Shia LaBeouf Would Trash-Talk ‘Lizzie McGuire’ While Filming ‘Even Stevens,’ Says Christy Carlson Romano: ‘He Wanted to Be the Number One Show’
articles.summary: Christy Carlson Romano, who first broke out on the sitcom “Even Stevens,” has revealed that co-star Shia LaBeouf used to trash-talk competing Disney Channel show “Lizzie McGuire” and that he was “definitely beefing” with the show’s star, Hilary Duff. “Hilary had no clue about that.
body: Last month, ahead of the release of her memoir, “Once Upon a Trainwreck: The Fall and Rise of a Child Star,” Romano said that she and LaBeouf were “like oil and water” while guesting on a podcast, despite being just 14 and 12 years old, respectively, at the time.
Romano explained that their on-set incompatibility stemmed from how they were raised.

“I was being raised and brought up to be this type A, I mean exactly like Ren Stevens. Like, you know your lines, you hit your marks, you don’t mess up,” she said. “You’re a New York kid, like that comes with a certain echelon… I was trying to go to pre-college Juilliard… everything we were doing, my mom called it cross-training, came with a certain dollar amount of training.”

In comparison, LaBeouf has long been open about his tumultuous childhood and has said that his father was a recovering addict, and at times abusive. “He was a Venice Beach kind of bum kid,” said Romano. “It’s like that kind of vagrant fun, but also very chaotic and very scary lifestyle, and he was very young to be having that.” She likened his upbringing to the lifestyle depicted in the 1995 Larry Clark film “Kids.”

articles.title: Cynthia Erivo Imagines Competing on ‘The Great British Bake Off’ in ‘SNL U.K.’ Opening Monologue: ‘I’ve Got a Soggy Bottom and I’m Freaking Stressed!’
articles.summary: In her opening “Saturday Night Live U.K.” monologue, Cynthia Erivo admitted that despite being an almost-EGOT – with an Emmy, Grammy and Tony to her name – there’s one accolade she’s still hankering after: no, not an Oscar but “the Hollywood handshake.” Erivo, who is hosting this weekend’s episode…
body: Earlier in the monologue Erivo told the audience the thing she’s asked about most is her trademark long nails. “Not quite sure why. To me, they’re normal. I’ve had them since I was 16,” she said. “They’re an extension of my body, an expression of my soul, and surprisingly practical. I haven’t had to use cutlery in years.”

Later, she referred to the nails again while picturing herself competing in the “Bake Off” tent. “It would be chaos,” she said. “Making cake batter with one nail, chopping my butter with the other. Noel’s telling me I’ve got 30 seconds left, and Alison just keeps laughing. It’s not funny, Hammond. Seriously, what are you laughing at? I’ve got a soggy bottom, and I’m freaking stressed!”
At which point Larry Dean, dressed as Fielding, jumped onto the “SNL” U.K. stage and warned Erivo she had 30 seconds left.
“No,” he replied. “The monologue! You need to get on the show.”

articles.title: TV stars to marry in chapel home after proposal 'on Welsh soil'
articles.summary: Keith Brymer Jones and Marj Hogarth are to marry in their chapel home in Pwllheli in May 2027.
body: The Great Pottery Throw Down judge Keith Brymer Jones has told how he and his partner are to marry in their north Wales chapel home after he proposed to her "on Welsh soil".
Jones said he and actor Marj Hogarth, who are renovating a Grade II-listed chapel in Pwllheli, were on tour "and I just thought I ought to really propose to her on Welsh soil".
He proposed during their show at the New Theatre in Cardiff, and "the idea is to get married in the main hall some time in May of next year".
The ceramicist also said there were a lot of derelict chapels across Wales and "we need to repurpose these buildings and give them a new lease of life".

articles.title: Jeff Garlin Considered Suicide After Tumultuous ‘Goldbergs’ Exit
articles.summary: The actor, who left the ABC comedy after an HR investigation stemming from multiple complaints about his behavior on set, says he reached out to his 'Curb Your Enthusiasm' onscreen wife Susie Essman to alert her to his plans.
body: After Jeff Garlin left the ABC comedy The Goldbergs following an HR investigation stemming from multiple complaints about his behavior, he struggled mentally to the point that he considered ending his life.
“I had a nervous breakdown, and I was going to commit suicide,” the actor said this week on Ted Danson ‘s Where Everybody Knows Your Name podcast.
“I reached out to Susie [Essman], and I said, ‘I hate when people don’t reach out, but at noon today I will be dead. I’m letting you know I will be dead.’,” the actor recalled.

“And she called [ex-wife] Marla, and she called [girlfriend] Sari and my friend, Brad Morris,” he said. “My girlfriend and my ex-wife called him. He’s one of my best friends. He watched me while they were looking for a place for me to go.”

articles.title: Apple TV Canceled This Breaking Bad Star's Sci-Fi Show Way Too Soon
articles.summary: Noomi Rapace and Breaking Bad's Jonathan Banks starred in this short-lived Apple TV sci-fi series, which involves parallel universes and other mysteries.
body: Peter Harness' "Constellation" ran on Apple TV from February to March 2021, lasting only eight episodes. The series stars Noomi Rapace as Jo Ericsson, a Swedish astronaut who, after a mysterious collision on the International Space Station, returns to Earth to learn that her life has been... somehow altered. Meanwhile, Jonathan Banks from "Breaking Bad" has an interesting dual role on "Constellation," playing both Henry Caldera and Bud Caldera, who are essentially the same man, just from different parallel universes.

"Constellation" is an oblique mystery-box series about Jo and what happened to her. The story sprawls across more than one dimension, and things get very complex very fast. You know that a show is heady and over-involved when critics and commentators are authoring articles about the potential symbolism in its featured background paintings. TV Obsessive even gave a complete rundown on the series' use of the art of Finnish painter Hugo Simberg. Tonally, it's dark and horrific, with images of angels and devils.

articles.title: Billy Corgan Defends Marilyn Manson Friendship Despite Sexual Assault Claims Against Manson: “I Didn’t Feel That He Was Guilty”
articles.summary: The Smashing Pumpkins frontman reflected on his 30-year relationship with the shock rocker, whose wife's twin sister is married to the Pumpkins' James Iha. "I don’t want the world to tell me who my friends are and who I should associate with,” he said.
body: Billy Corgan has defended his ongoing friendship with Marilyn Manson despite the latter being accused of sexual assault and abuse by multiple women.

“As a Christian person, you have to stand by your friends, but that doesn’t mean you don’t have an opinion, and it doesn’t mean you’re not critical,” Corgan said on the New York Times ‘ Popcast earlier this week. “In his case — and I’m not here to adjudicate it — but the D.A. looked at the case for five years.”

Los Angeles County District Attorney Nathan Hochman announced in January 2025, after investigating for four years, that his office wouldn’t pursue criminal charges against Manson, whose real name is Brian Warner, saying the statute of limitations had run out on the domestic violence claims against him and that prosecutors couldn’t prove charges of sexual assault beyond a reasonable doubt.

articles.title: Cillian Murphy's Supernatural Thriller With Robert De Niro Was Dead On Arrival
articles.summary: This supernatural thriller couldn't overcome its underlying silliness, even with a cast that included Cillian Murphy, Robert De Niro, and Elizabeth Olsen.
body: Rodrigo Cortés' 2012 thriller "Red Lights," starring Cillian Murphy, Robert De Niro, Sigourney Weaver, and a pre-Marvel Cinematic Universe Elizabeth Olsen, has a very strange premise indeed. Murphy plays Tom Buckley, a physicist who works with psychology Professor Margaret Matheson (Weaver) in a college department devoted to debunking the supernatural. For them, this is a dogged and aggressive fight, and "Red Lights" presents fake psychics and bogus faith-healers as being among the world's worst villains.

Tom and Margaret's nemesis is Simon Silver (De Niro), a blind TV psychic who hasn't performed for years. Silver retired years earlier after one of his critics, an avowed skeptic, mysteriously died from a heart issue. Silver, however, now plans on returning to the spotlight, spurring Tom to try and either confirm or deny his fraudulence once and for all.

Of course, Tom and Margaret don't have such an easy time of it. You see, years earlier, Margaret had a run-in with Silver that actually made her doubt her devotion to a world without psychic powers, so she is reluctant to pursue him. Meanwhile, Olsen plays Sally Owen, a younger college student who aids Tom.
points: This supernatural thriller couldn't overcome its underlying silliness, even with a cast that included Cillian Murphy, Robert De Niro, and Elizabeth Olsen.
